method: Independent Python accumulation over raw line-item rows for product selection; full-quarter total checked against raw-table reference. Developer-authored cases informed implementation.

cases.question: Compare completed revenue in Q3 and Q4 2025. Return Q3 revenue, Q4 revenue and percentage growth rounded to two decimals.

result.sql: WITH quarterly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date) AS period, SUM(revenue_aed) AS measure, 100.0 * AVG(refunded_item) AS refund_rate FROM completed_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date) IN (3, 4) GROUP BY period), compared AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN period = 3 THEN measure END) AS previous_value, MAX(CASE WHEN period = 4 THEN measure END) AS current_value FROM quarterly) SELECT ROUND(previous_value, 2) AS q3_revenue_aed, ROUND(current_value, 2) AS q4_revenue_aed, ROUND(100.0 * (current_value - previous_value) / NULLIF(previous_value, 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM compared

WITH quarterly AS (
      SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date) AS period, SUM(revenue_aed) AS measure,
             100.0*AVG(refunded_item) AS refund_rate
      FROM completed_sales
      WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)=2025
        AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date) IN (3,4)
      GROUP BY period
    ), compared AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN period=3 THEN measure END) AS previous_value, MAX(CASE WHEN period=4 THEN measure END) AS current_value FROM quarterly )
    SELECT ROUND(previous_value,2) AS q3_revenue_aed, ROUND(current_value,2) AS q4_revenue_aed, ROUND(100.0*(current_value-previous_value)/NULLIF(previous_value,0),2) AS growth_pct FROM compared

cases.question: Which products grew revenue from Q3 to Q4 2025 while their refund rate increased?

result.sql: WITH quarterly AS (SELECT product_name, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date) AS period, SUM(revenue_aed) AS measure, 100.0 * AVG(refunded_item) AS refund_rate FROM completed_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date) IN (3, 4) GROUP BY product_name, period), compared AS (SELECT product_name, MAX(CASE WHEN period = 3 THEN measure END) AS previous_value, MAX(CASE WHEN period = 4 THEN measure END) AS current_value, MAX(CASE WHEN period = 3 THEN refund_rate END) AS previous_refund_rate, MAX(CASE WHEN period = 4 THEN refund_rate END) AS current_refund_rate FROM quarterly GROUP BY product_name) SELECT product_name, ROUND(previous_value, 2) AS q3_revenue_aed, ROUND(current_value, 2) AS q4_revenue_aed, ROUND(100.0 * (current_value - previous_value) / NULLIF(previous_value, 0), 2) AS growth_pct, ROUND(previous_refund_rate, 2) AS q3_refund_rate_pct, ROUND(current_refund_rate, 2) AS q4_refund_rate_pct, ROUND(current_refund_rate - previous_refund_rate, 2) AS refund_change_pp FROM compared WHERE current_value > previous_value AND current_refund_rate > previous_refund_rate ORDER BY growth_pct DESC, product_name
